boundedDocumentReferenceAllowed.reason: Reuses the reviewed document authorization reader (as the bounded document routes do) and applies the literal reference predicate: an exact ID or slug match with documentRole != none. SW495 compares open, team, private, slug and missing document references across every principal and credential.

boundedSelectedDocument.temperatureReason: Document favorite/subscription reference authorization for a selected-team credential.
boundedSelectedDocument.reason: Applies the literal key projection (teams, team settings and team members on the key's allow-list; the document team/inherited/closed-link filters of filterBootstrapForAPIKey and applyAPIKeyProjection) to the reviewed document read before the literal reference predicate. SW495 covers selected-empty and selected-set credentials.
